was $11.2 billion. Of our total remaining deal value, as of December 31, 2025, $6.8 billion was the remaining deal value of our contracts with commercial customers and $4.4 billion was the remaining deal value of our contracts with government customers.
Many of these contracts are subject to termination for convenience provisions. Additionally, the U.S. federal government is prohibited from exercising contract options more than one year in advance. As a result, there can be no guarantee that our customer contracts will not be terminated or that contract options will be exercised.
We historically have not realized all of the revenue from the full deal value of our customer contracts, and we may not do so in the future. This is because the actual timing and amount of revenue under contracts included are subject to various contingencies, including exercise of contractual options, customers not terminating their contracts, renegotiation of contracts, and other macroeconomic factors that may potentially inhibit a customer s ability to pay. In addition, delays in the completion of the U.S. government s budgeting process, the use of continuing resolutions, and a potential lapse in appropriations, or similar events in other jurisdictions, have and could in the future adversely affect our ability to timely recognize revenue under certain government contracts. If we are unable to realize all of the revenue from the full deal value of our customer contracts, our financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected.
If we fail to manage future growth effectively, our business could be harmed.

項目7. 経営陣による財政状態及び経営成績の分析

概要
総残存取引額は112億ドルであった。2025年12月31日現在、商業顧客との契約残存額は68億ドル、政府顧客との契約残存額は44億ドルであった。

これらの契約の多くは便宜による解約条項の対象となり、米国連邦政府は契約オプションを1年以上前に行使できないため、契約の継続やオプション行使を保証できない。

当社は過去に顧客契約の全取引額からの収益をすべて実現しておらず、今後も同様の可能性がある。収益の時期・金額は、契約オプションの行使、顧客による非解約、契約再交渉、顧客の支払能力に影響するマクロ経済要因等の偶発事象に左右される。また、米国政府の予算編成遅延、継続決議、歳出停止等の事象は、政府契約に基づく収益認識に悪影響を及ぼしており、契約全額からの収益実現ができない場合、財政状態及び経営成績に悪影響を及ぼす可能性がある。
